criteria.report: report all eight paired outcomes and feature errors; exploratory extension, not independent confirmatory or generalization claim

matching: both conditions identical fixture, initial RGB hashes, 16 recovery rounds, .45 simulation seconds per round, close/lift/hold commands; differs only image-derived corrections
scope: Same scene/base/camera/seed. Large unseen joint-command perturbations, outside training radius on negative side. Close/lift/approach remain demonstration playback. No tuning/retraining after either cohort.
cost: local numpy/OpenCV fit; no neural network/LLM/API calls; record wall time and raw servo action count
source_sha: the commit containing this declaration (resolve with git history)
rationale: Small 6-case cohort succeeds 6/6 in both conditions; increase perturbation without changing model/controller to measure recovery envelope. Full factorial rather than chosen successful cases.
